DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 INT NOT NULL, c2 INT) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 2)
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v WITH SCHEMA TYPE EVOLUTION AS SELECT * FROM t
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 STRING NOT NULL, c2 DOUBLE) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES ('1', 2.0)
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 STRING, c2 DOUBLE, c3 DATE) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES ('1', 2.0, DATE'2022-01-01')
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 INT, c2 INT) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 2)
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v WITH SCHEMA TYPE EVOLUTION AS SELECT * FROM t
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 INT) USING PARQUET
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c3 INT, c2 INT) USING PARQUET
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 INT COMMENT 'c1', c2 INT COMMENT 'c2') USING PARQUET
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v(a1, a2) WITH SCHEMA TYPE EVOLUTION AS SELECT * FROM t
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 BIGINT COMMENT 'c1 6a', c2 STRING COMMENT 'c2 6a') USING PARQUET
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v(a1 COMMENT 'a1', a2 COMMENT 'a2') WITH SCHEMA TYPE EVOLUTION AS SELECT * FROM t
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 BIGINT COMMENT 'c1 6b', c2 STRING COMMENT 'c2 6b') USING PARQUET
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 INT) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES(1)
DDL	CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION AS SELECT * FROM t
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
DDL	CREATE TABLE t(c1 STRING) USING PARQUET
WRITE	INSERT INTO t VALUES('1')
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
DDL	ALTER VIEW v WITH SCHEMA TYPE EVOLUTION
READ	SELECT * FROM v
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED v
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v
DDL	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t
